prompt: A completely randomized experiment has $40$ subjects and $4$ treatments, with equal-sized groups. How many subjects receive each treatment?
hint: "Equal-sized groups" tells you the subjects are shared out evenly, one group for each treatment.

hints.text: "Equal-sized groups" tells you the subjects are shared out evenly, one group for each treatment.
There are $40$ subjects to share among $4$ treatment groups of the same size, so divide $40$ by $4$.
$40 \div 4 = 10$, so each treatment is given to $10$ subjects.

explanation: In a completely randomized design, every subject is assigned by chance to exactly one treatment group.
The groups must be the same size, so the $40$ subjects are split evenly: $\frac{40}{4} = 10$.
Each of the four treatments is received by $10$ subjects.

alternativeExplanations.title: How the assignment is done
steps: Number the subjects 1 to 40 and use a random number generator to pick 10 for treatment 1.
Pick 10 of the remaining 30 for treatment 2, then 10 of the remaining 20 for treatment 3.
The last 10 get treatment 4. Random, and 10 per group.
